cohort: The study included 92 women with urinary tract endometriosis and 234 women with deep infiltrating endometriosis from the First Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University.
finding: Patients with urinary tract endometriosis had lower physical health scores (PCS) but similar mental health scores (MCS) compared to those with deep infiltrating endometriosis, with painkiller use, awareness of urologic abnormalities, and history of more than two miscarriages identified as factors influencing health scores.
